message.content:
The user now needs to confirm the entered phone number and enter the SMS editing interface. In the upper right corner of the interface, there is a check button (ImageView); clicking it will confirm the number and proceed to the next step. Therefore, a Tap action should be performed on the check button, with the element being the corresponding bounds. According to the structure, the bounds of the ImageView are [882, 123, 999, 175], so the Tap action will be executed.


do(action="Tap", element=[940,149])
